tools.name: bending-adder-20261012.json
tools.description: Choose reviewed blood, water or sparkle bending templates in one editor window, validate their references and bone placement, and add missing effects with Undo. Existing objects remain unchanged; a separate verified sparkle bending source must be supplied.
tools.command_template: Install the reviewed editor source set described in docs/avatar-effects-editor-tools-20261012.md; then open Tools/Unity Unicorn/bending-adder.
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the intended avatar project and its legitimately acquired asset dependencies.
Review the source and keep a recoverable project baseline before applying changes.
limitations: Editor source preview; standalone compilation is not Unity or VRChat runtime verification.
Private learned templates, third-party assets and actual use records are not bundled.
